name: Shimei
overview: The name Shimei appears in Scripture associated with various individuals, including a son of Gershon and a Benjamite who notably cursed King David during his flight from Absalom. This Shimei, son of Gera, openly reproached David with harsh words and even cast stones at him, accusing him of bloodshed and divine judgment (2 Samuel 16:5-8). Despite this, David's response demonstrated magnanimity and trust in God's sovereignty. The diversity of persons named Shimei reflects the name's prominence across different tribes and roles in Israel's history.
